name: NICKEL PRATT
note: PRATT AT THE COUNTER (doc 57 D6: 'PRA_D6 option 5; the next time Thad enters the Registrar's, Pratt is at the counter'). Room 7's four image operations are spent, so he is his Prosperity sheet, mallet in hand, as he walked home from D2 -- for Tyler's playthrough. Room 7's arrival scene is the attestation (onEnter.sayLines, from doc 57); once it is read (T_ATTESTED) he walks out of the door.
walkToNote: Beside him along the counter, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Pratt.

sprite.frameNote: 0 the mallet resting on the ground · 1 breath (derived) · 2 the mallet on his shoulder. Every `breakEvery` seconds he shoulders it (errata 77). Not 3 or 4: there is no stake here.
sprite.statureNote: The bigger man: room-25's master drew him 1.05 of Thad; 1.03 keeps him inside the 5% a standing man is held to (tests/scale.test.ts).
sprite.figureHeightNote: Crown to sole, his hat excluded: 0.913 of the drawn rest frame, as measured on the rake row of the same sheet (the hat-brim reading is thrown here by the mallet's handle).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 101 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 19 (reference/cast-unify-17.txt), full figure, his mallet in every pose so it never appears or vanishes; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge on his feet; its own file.
sprite.buildNote: LEANER (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "standing next to Thad Pratt look like a much 'thicker' character"; he chose "Leaner, still sturdy"): redrawn in the same poses, an ordinary working man a little broader than Thad (cast-unify 49), cut by tools/art/cast-unify-cut.py; figureHeight is crown to sole, the hat not counted (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat).

exit.note: Doc 57 D6: attested, he goes -- in front of the queue rope, not through it, and out by the street door at the left.
exit.walkNote: WALK-C: six frames posed on Thad's walk, the leaner Pratt (cast-unify 50; Tyler, 2026-11-06: "Pratt's gait is kind of awkward because his knee goes so high" -- briefed with low knees), cut by tools/art/walk-c.py; figureHeight crown to sole on the passing frame, as his standing frames are measured. strideRatio MEASURED FROM THESE FRAMES (R5f), calibrated on Thad's walk.
exit.speedNote: Tyler, 2026-11-06: "Pratt walks so slow it's hard to even figure out if his walk could be good." Was 80 px/s, a fifth of his height a second. Now Deke's pace, which Tyler passed ("pretty good"): half his drawn height a second, 198 px/s for a man of about 396 px here.
